subject: Film & Cinema
title: Cinema's Uncertain Future
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Cinema's Uncertain Future.

hook.text: AI can generate scripts, deepfakes can recreate dead actors, and theaters keep closing.

buildup.text: The film industry faces technology, labor disputes, and audience fragmentation all at once.

discovery.text: Yet every crisis in cinema history — sound, TV, streaming — led to reinvention, not death.

twist.text: The desire to sit in a dark room with strangers and feel something has outlasted every threat.

climax.text: Cinema's medium changes constantly. Its purpose never does.

quiz.question: What has cinema's history shown about technological threats?
options: Technology has no effect on film
